adds.title: Bill C-75 (incorporating Bill C-32) - Repeal of Criminal Code Section 159
adds.summary: Assented 2019-06-21, S.C. 2019, c. 25 repealed Criminal Code section 159 criminalizing anal intercourse in Canada including Yukon and barred conviction for any historical sexual offence unless the act would constitute an offence if committed on the day the charge was laid.
